integrity_notes: Proof is analytic and self-contained modulo standard conditional-negative-type/Gaussian kernel equivalence. The standalone finite checker is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to existing thick generalized quadrangles only (s,t at least 2); no existence theorem for arbitrary parameter pairs.
Does not cover generalized hexagons, modified edge weights, or arbitrary non-incidence metrics.
An equivalent older finite-association-scheme computation cannot be categorically excluded by the inspected bibliography.
title: Exact negative-type threshold for generalized-quadrangle incidence metrics
